selection: All 12 previously screened fee-500 pools, before inspecting added-asset strategy returns. No return-based reselection or parameter tuning.
accounting: One funded continuous portfolio per asset/candidate/scenario/size; weekly and session attribution never resets inventory or benchmark.
scope: Retrospective conditional recorded-market-path comparison. Historical eligibility and cost receipts unavailable. Reserved September 11 20:00 onward excluded.
inclusionRequirements: Canonical complete event capture and archive start/end state reconciliation
Complete per-asset entry, restored exit, recenter and passive swap cost bundles
A common largest-budget passive acquisition within the replay window
exclusionRules: Record missing or failed mechanics/canonical evidence per asset; never substitute another asset cost bundle
Missing initialized canonical range boundaries alone do not exclude virtual-boundary research when all transaction stages pass
universeLimitations: September 13 discovery and liquidity screen is retrospective and can contain survival/availability selection bias
Only the 12 pre-screened V3/USDG fee-500 pools, not all 194 assets or all historical pools
Original 50 bps 5000 USDG screen excludes four additional pool rows; small-size viability is not ruled out
initialAvailability: Cash at July 28; each asset waits for the first event block permitting largest-budget passive acquisition, shared across sizes. Different asset availability dates are reported.
retainedControls: AAPL/GOOGL source and results are verified against the prior long study. All new captures and decisions use the same frozen core.
